Is this one different to Coppola's restoration? I have the Coppola version on TV but I'm not sure whether the original theatrical of Napoleon was colour tinted the way Coppola's is, and certainly the orchestra arrangements are different for his version cause he got Carmine Coppola to do it.

Always been miffed about that cause I'd love to see the film as it originally was released.
The huge cinematheque complete restoration (which took more than 10 years) will be screened in Paris this July, and certainly released soon after. It is probably better to wait for it.

They talk about 7+ hours in the articles about it. They started working on it in 2007, made an huge work of comparing the 22 existing versions, undo all, trying to reconstruct the first original one... 4 millions project, Netflix finally gave money for it to be achieved.
damn i hope that gets posted too
